MTEX1::process returns immediately unless leftExpander.module (+0xe8) has modelMegaTang as its model, so the module is completely inert anywhere except directly to the right of a MEGA-TANG. It has no outputs, which is why the census lists none.

A debug printf was left in: printf is called with the format "ex1: C1 From: %.2f To: %.2f\n" on every sample while the module is attached. MEGA-TANG prints its own line in the same condition. This is the most visible fault in the plugin and it is in the shipping build.

The Level knob applies only to the Line In. The In 5 and In 6 jacks are written into the mix message unscaled, so they always arrive at full level; their knobs are sends only.

The send taken from the Line In is taken before the Level knob, not after it (the raw voltage is multiplied by param 0), so lowering the Level does not lower that send.

The Line In jack is named Variable in the maker's tooltip and Line In on the panel. The panel is the name used here.

All four knobs are configured 0 to 1 with a default of 0 and a display multiplier of 100.
